name: EPIC 206100831
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 10.6 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,729 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.89 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,909 K at its surface.
